name: fuzz_domain
description: Generate and analyze domain permutations to detect potential typosquatting, phishing, and brand impersonation

nameservers.description: Comma-separated DNS servers: IPv4 addresses or DNS-over-HTTPS URLs such as https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query (default: 1.1.1.1)

mxcheck.description: Check whether each mail server would accept email for any address, so it could intercept mail sent to typos of your domain

ssdeep.description: Deprecated alias for lsh: "ssdeep" (ignored when lsh is set)

lsh.description: Compare each permutation's web page with the original using a fuzzy hash (slow) to spot cloned phishing pages

whois.description: Look up WHOIS creation date and registrar for each domain (slower)

all_records.description: Return all DNS records instead of only the first of each type

fuzzers.description: Only use these fuzzing algorithms (default: all)

banners.description: Capture HTTP and SMTP server banners
